card.name: Word starting a clause in making or crafting text
card.fires_on: Short words such as I, he, and, or, is that begin a new clause in how-to or materials text about making things (crafts, textiles, manufacturing). It also fires on the first letter of a list item or term.

modes.description: The first letter of an item in a list of applications or glossary terms.

card.writes: It nudges output toward words like machine, builder, fabric and automation, which fits making and manufacturing.
